title: Lauak Sapistan
description: Lauak Sapistan (Lauh-e-Sapistan) is a unique, soothing Unani linctus (lickable herbal paste) primarily prepared from Sapistan (Cordia myxa) fruit for throat care. This classical formulation provides instant relief from acute colds. Addresses catarrh (nasal discharge and congestion). Relieves painful coughs through soothing and moisturizing action. Treats throat hoarseness. Reduces excessive mucus secretions.
dosage: 5–10 grams to be licked slowly from a spoon 2–3 times a day
